# 文献層: メカ設計(機械設計)

<!-- generated by tools/gen_literature_notes.py from the RAD corpus mech_design_corpus_v2 (built 2026-09-21); do not edit by hand -->

**何のコーパスか**: CAD 表現(パラメトリック・B-rep・CSG・SDF)、generative design・トポロジー最適化、DfAM・格子、公差解析・GD&T、機構合成・コンプライアント機構、歯車・軸受・ボルト、疲労・強度・FEA、材料選定、射出成形・板金の設計ルール、DFA/DFM、ロボット機構、逆設計(点群 → CAD)、スライス・工具経路。

**Fullseye でなぜ要るか**: 設計 → スライス → 印刷 → 検査 → 再設計 の閉ループ(`printpath` と SDF/CSG の族、進化エンジン)の設計側の知識。

**来歴**: OpenAlex から取得した論文メタデータ **2,240 本**(2012 年以降、`fetch_openalex_topical.py`)を TF-IDF + k-means で **64 クラスタ**に階層化し(raptor の `corpus2skill`、2026-09-21)、各クラスタの要約を LLM(claude-haiku-4-5)が書いた。ここに載せるのは**その要約と、代表論文の題名・著者・年・DOI だけ**(メタデータは CC0。抄録は出版社の権利なので写さない)。要約は生成時の英語のまま。**正直な限界**: 文献は原理・選定・校正の研究が中心で、型番やデータシートの数値(製品知識)は薄い。

**使い方(op に落とす)**: 各クラスタの「**使う op**」は、知識のテーマ → op の対応表(`tools/gen_literature_notes.py` の `THEME_OPS`、人が書いたもの)で引いた**実在の op**(生成時に出荷ノート 2,660 本の一覧と突き合わせ、無ければ止まる)。op の後ろはなぜ使うかと型。テーマに当たらないクラスタは「op に落ちていない」と書く(Fullseye に無い領域を隠さない)。読む順: 工程・部品の話題 → クラスタ → 使う op → op ノート(型の契約・実行できる例)→ 実装。末尾の「op → クラスタ」で逆に引ける。

## point / shape / cloud

**175 本**

This cluster covers computational techniques for processing, analyzing, and reconstructing 3D geometric structures from point clouds and shape data. It encompasses deep learning approaches, transformation algorithms, reverse engineering methodologies, and implicit representation methods for 3D geometry understanding and generation.

- **Point Cloud Processing**: Neural network architectures (Transformers, attention mechanisms) designed for irregular, unordered 3D point data
- **3D Shape Representation**: Multiple encoding strategies including explicit meshes, implicit functions, signed distance fields, and constructive solid geometry
- **Reverse Engineering Workflows**: Multi-sensor acquisition, registration algorithms, and optimization techniques for reconstructing geometry from physical objects or scans
- **Deep Geometry Learning**: Feature extraction and learning paradigms adapted from 2D computer vision to handle 3D geometric irregularities
- **Implicit Representations**: Neural implicit functions and signed distance functions for efficient 3D shape synthesis and reconstruction

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- 点群 → 当てはめ → CAD(逆設計): [`voxel_grid_downsample`](../ops/3d/preprocess/voxel_grid_downsample.md)(スキャン点群を等間隔に間引く、points → points)、[`statistical_outlier_removal`](../ops/3d/preprocess/statistical_outlier_removal.md)(外れ点を落とす、points → points)、[`estimate_normals`](../ops/3d/curvature/estimate_normals.md)(法線(面の向き)、points → normals)、[`icp_point2plane`](../ops/3d/refine/icp_point2plane.md)(設計形状との位置合わせ、points × points × normals → pose)、[`register_fpfh`](../ops/3d/feature_register/register_fpfh.md)(初期姿勢の無い位置合わせ、points × points → pose)、[`ransac_plane`](../ops/3d/robust_fit/ransac_plane.md)(平面プリミティブの当てはめ、points → primitive)、[`ransac_cylinder`](../ops/3d/robust_fit/ransac_cylinder.md)(円筒の当てはめ(穴・軸)、points × normals → primitive)、[`fit_cone`](../ops/3d/robust_fit/fit_cone.md)(円錐、points → primitive)
- メッシュ・形状の計測と変換: [`mesh_area`](../ops/3d/mesh_process/mesh_area.md)(表面積、mesh → measurement)、[`mesh_volume`](../ops/3d/mesh_process/mesh_volume.md)(体積、mesh → measurement)、[`vertex_curvature`](../ops/3d/mesh_process/vertex_curvature.md)(曲率(角・フィレット)、mesh → curvature)、[`decimate_qem`](../ops/3d/mesh_process/decimate_qem.md)(間引き、mesh → mesh)、[`mesh_isotropic_remesh`](../ops/3d/resolution/mesh_isotropic_remesh.md)(等方リメッシュ、mesh → mesh)、[`mesh_to_voxel`](../ops/3d/transform/mesh_to_voxel.md)(メッシュ → 体積、mesh → voxel)、[`mesh_sample_points`](../ops/3d/resolution/mesh_sample_points.md)(メッシュ → 点群、mesh → points)、[`shape_index`](../ops/3d/curvature/shape_index.md)(局所形状の型、points → descriptor)
- パラメトリック形状(SDF / CSG): [`box_sdf`](../ops/3d/sdf_csg/box_sdf.md)(直方体の SDF、coordgrid → sdf)、[`cylinder_sdf`](../ops/3d/sdf_csg/cylinder_sdf.md)(円筒の SDF、coordgrid → sdf)、[`capsule_sdf`](../ops/3d/sdf_csg/capsule_sdf.md)(カプセル、coordgrid → sdf)、[`plane_sdf`](../ops/3d/sdf_csg/plane_sdf.md)(平面(切り欠き)、coordgrid → sdf)、[`sdf_union`](../ops/3d/sdf_csg/sdf_union.md)(和、sdf × sdf → sdf)、[`sdf_subtract`](../ops/3d/sdf_csg/sdf_subtract.md)(差(穴)、sdf × sdf → sdf)、[`sdf_intersect`](../ops/3d/sdf_csg/sdf_intersect.md)(積、sdf × sdf → sdf)、[`sdf_smooth_union`](../ops/3d/sdf_csg/sdf_smooth_union.md)(フィレットつきの和、sdf × sdf → sdf)

## cad / parametric / design

**88 本**

This cluster covers parametric and generative design methodologies in CAD systems, emphasizing how design intent is captured through parameters, constraints, and automation. It addresses the integration of parametric modeling with AI/LLMs, design complexity management, and best practices for creating reusable, editable digital product models across engineering domains.

- **Parametric modeling fundamentals**: History-based parametric CAD enables design intent capture, making models editable and reusable; complexity and parameter relationships directly impact model maintainability
- **Design-to-manufacturing automation**: Generative AI and LLMs can bridge CAD systems with downstream manufacturing processes, reducing manual handoff and iteration cycles
- **Model complexity metrics**: Quantitative analysis of parametric model complexity correlates with perceived usability; high-complexity models resist reuse and redesign
- **Domain-specific parametric systems**: Knowledge-based parametric modeling (e.g., gear design, spine biomechanics) embeds engineering rules and constraints to automate specialized design tasks
- **Integration with analysis tools**: Parametric CAD/CAE environments unify design and simulation in a single workspace, enabling iterative design optimization

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

## fatigue / bolted / joints

**206 本**

This cluster addresses the mechanical behavior, fatigue performance, and structural integrity of bolted joints and fastened assemblies. It encompasses analysis methods (finite element, system dynamics), failure mechanisms (looseness, fatigue), and detection techniques for ensuring reliability in critical infrastructure, aerospace, automotive, and biomedical applications.

- **Bolt looseness detection** can be automated using deep learning and acoustic/ultrasonic monitoring methods to prevent catastrophic failure in infrastructure
- **Fatigue resistance** in bolted connections is influenced by preload, vibration, cyclic loading, and material properties; high-speed dynamic environments require enhanced assessment approaches
- **Finite element analysis (FEA)** provides a unified computational framework for analyzing complex structures with bolted joints under various loading conditions
- **Joint stiffness and gasket behavior** significantly affect load distribution, stress concentration, and fatigue life in bolted assemblies
- **Material properties** (polymers, composites, ceramics, hard carbons) interact with joint design to determine overall strength, toughness, and fatigue performance

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- き裂・ひずみ・損傷の画像計測: [`strain_from_displacement`](../ops/piv/solid/strain_from_displacement.md)(全視野ひずみ、image2d × image2d → image2d)、[`piv_multipass`](../ops/piv/estimate/piv_multipass.md)(多段の変位推定、image2d × image2d → flow2d)、[`motion_magnify`](../ops/motionmag/magnify/motion_magnify.md)(微小変形の拡大、video → table)、[`displacement_series`](../ops/motionmag/measure/displacement_series.md)(変位の時系列、video → pairs)、[`vol_frangi`](../ops/3d/feature/vol_frangi.md)(CT 中の管状き裂の強調、voxel → voxel)、[`canny`](../ops/2d/segmentation/canny.md)(き裂のエッジ、image → region)、[`hessian3d`](../ops/3d/feature/hessian3d.md)(3D の線状構造、voxel → hessian)、[`distance_ridge`](../ops/3d/medial/distance_ridge.md)(き裂の中心線、voxel → voxel)
- 機械要素(歯車・ねじ・機構): [`polar_unwrap`](../ops/3d/curvilinear/polar_unwrap.md)(歯車の極座標展開(歯形)、image2d → image2d)、[`cylinder_unwrap`](../ops/3d/curvilinear/cylinder_unwrap.md)(円筒面の展開(ねじ山)、voxel → voxel)、[`m1_measure_pairs`](../ops/2d/measure1d/m1_measure_pairs.md)(歯厚・ピッチ、image → feature)、[`edges_sub_pix`](../ops/2d/contour/edges_sub_pix.md)(歯形の輪郭、image → contour)、[`envelope_spectrum`](../ops/acoustics/bearing/envelope_spectrum.md)(歯車の噛み合い振動、signal → table)、[`order_spectrum`](../ops/acoustics/order/order_spectrum.md)(次数スペクトル、signal → table)、[`segment_rigid_motions`](../ops/3d/motion_segment/segment_rigid_motions.md)(機構の動く部品の分離、points × points → labels)

## optimization / topology / design

**256 本**

This cluster covers optimization methodologies applied to topology and design problems, ranging from structural engineering and metamaterial design to chemical processes and reservoir management. It encompasses techniques like topology optimization, surrogate modeling, genetic algorithms, and level set methods used to discover optimal configurations while satisfying manufacturing, performance, and computational constraints.

- **Topology Optimization Methods**: Level set functions, density-based approaches, and genetic algorithms enable automated discovery of optimal structural layouts and hole insertion strategies
- **Inverse Design Frameworks**: Machine learning and backpropagation-based approaches allow target-driven material and structure discovery without exhaustive design space exploration
- **Surrogate Modeling**: Reduced-order models and neural networks approximate expensive simulations, enabling efficient multi-objective optimization in complex domains
- **Metamaterial Design**: Topology optimization produces subwavelength bandgaps and energy-absorbing structures with novel acoustic and mechanical properties
- **Manufacturing Constraints**: Moldability conditions, casting feasibility, and fabrication limitations must be integrated as explicit constraints in optimization formulations

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- トポロジー最適化・格子構造の評価 —— 入口: 進化エンジン(`docs/ENGINE.md`、`docs/EVOLUTION_ENVIRONMENT.md`)は設計パラメータを適応度で回す側
- トポロジー最適化・格子構造の評価: [`vol_euler_number`](../ops/3d/feature/vol_euler_number.md)(連結性(閉じた空隙の数)、voxel → measurement)、[`vol_wall_thickness`](../ops/3d/probe/vol_wall_thickness.md)(最小肉厚、voxel → signal)、[`edt_jfa`](../ops/3d/feature/edt_jfa.md)(距離変換(肉厚・隙間)、voxel → sdf)、[`vol_granulometry`](../ops/3d/feature/vol_granulometry.md)(空隙の大きさ分布、voxel → measurement)、[`mesh_volume`](../ops/3d/mesh_process/mesh_volume.md)(体積(材料量)、mesh → measurement)、[`inertia_tensor`](../ops/3d/moment_invariant/inertia_tensor.md)(慣性テンソル、points → matrix)、[`principal_moments`](../ops/3d/moment_invariant/principal_moments.md)(主慣性モーメント、points → descriptor)
- アクチュエータ(制御は外、動きを画像で測る側): [`displacement_series`](../ops/motionmag/measure/displacement_series.md)(変位の時系列、video → pairs)、[`phase_displacement`](../ops/motionmag/measure/phase_displacement.md)(位相ベースの微小変位、video → table)、[`riesz_displacement_series`](../ops/quat/motion/riesz_displacement_series.md)(Riesz 変換の変位、video → pairs)、[`temporal_band_power`](../ops/motionmag/temporal/temporal_band_power.md)(帯域ごとの動きの量、video → image2d)、[`band_snr`](../ops/motionmag/temporal/band_snr.md)(動きの SN、video → table)、[`order_spectrum`](../ops/acoustics/order/order_spectrum.md)(回転次数、signal → table)、[`angular_resample`](../ops/acoustics/order/angular_resample.md)(回転同期、signal → table)、[`piv_multipass`](../ops/piv/estimate/piv_multipass.md)(流体(油空圧)の流れ場、image2d × image2d → flow2d)
- 機械要素(歯車・ねじ・機構): [`polar_unwrap`](../ops/3d/curvilinear/polar_unwrap.md)(歯車の極座標展開(歯形)、image2d → image2d)、[`cylinder_unwrap`](../ops/3d/curvilinear/cylinder_unwrap.md)(円筒面の展開(ねじ山)、voxel → voxel)、[`m1_measure_pairs`](../ops/2d/measure1d/m1_measure_pairs.md)(歯厚・ピッチ、image → feature)、[`edges_sub_pix`](../ops/2d/contour/edges_sub_pix.md)(歯形の輪郭、image → contour)、[`envelope_spectrum`](../ops/acoustics/bearing/envelope_spectrum.md)(歯車の噛み合い振動、signal → table)、[`segment_rigid_motions`](../ops/3d/motion_segment/segment_rigid_motions.md)(機構の動く部品の分離、points × points → labels)

## robot / robotic / control

**239 本**

This cluster covers the design, actuation, and control of robotic systems ranging from compliant mechanisms to soft robots. It encompasses mechanical engineering principles, actuator technologies, and locomotion strategies that enable robots to interact safely with humans and dynamic environments.

- **Soft robotics fundamentals**: Pneumatic networks, dielectric elastomer actuators, and flexible materials enable compliant, safe robot designs with integrated actuation and sensing
- **Actuator technologies**: Piezoelectric, pneumatic, and bistable actuators provide diverse control modalities for different robotic scales and applications
- **Compliant mechanisms**: Flexible structures that achieve motion through material deformation rather than rigid joints, reducing complexity and improving human-robot safety
- **Gripper design**: Soft gripping strategies enable adaptive grasping through actuation control, geometry, and smart material selection
- **Locomotion strategies**: Crawling, undulation, and other gaits leverage soft body dynamics for navigation in constrained and unstructured environments

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- アクチュエータ(制御は外、動きを画像で測る側): [`displacement_series`](../ops/motionmag/measure/displacement_series.md)(変位の時系列、video → pairs)、[`phase_displacement`](../ops/motionmag/measure/phase_displacement.md)(位相ベースの微小変位、video → table)、[`riesz_displacement_series`](../ops/quat/motion/riesz_displacement_series.md)(Riesz 変換の変位、video → pairs)、[`temporal_band_power`](../ops/motionmag/temporal/temporal_band_power.md)(帯域ごとの動きの量、video → image2d)、[`band_snr`](../ops/motionmag/temporal/band_snr.md)(動きの SN、video → table)、[`order_spectrum`](../ops/acoustics/order/order_spectrum.md)(回転次数、signal → table)、[`angular_resample`](../ops/acoustics/order/angular_resample.md)(回転同期、signal → table)、[`piv_multipass`](../ops/piv/estimate/piv_multipass.md)(流体(油空圧)の流れ場、image2d × image2d → flow2d)
- ロボット(姿勢・位置合わせ・動き) —— 入口: `docs/PERCEPTION_PHYSICAL_AI.md`
- ロボット(姿勢・位置合わせ・動き): [`pnp_ransac`](../ops/3d/pose_estimation/pnp_ransac.md)(カメラから物体の姿勢、points × keypoints → pose)、[`dlt_pose`](../ops/3d/pose_estimation/dlt_pose.md)(姿勢の直接解、points × keypoints → pose)、[`reprojection_error`](../ops/3d/pose_estimation/reprojection_error.md)(姿勢の検証、points × keypoints → measurement)、[`optimize_pose_graph`](../ops/3d/pose_graph/optimize_pose_graph.md)(軌跡の整合、pose → table)、[`relative_pose`](../ops/3d/pose_graph/relative_pose.md)(相対姿勢、pose × pose → pose)、[`register_cpd_rigid`](../ops/3d/deform/register_cpd_rigid.md)(剛体の位置合わせ、points × points → pose)、[`icp_point2plane`](../ops/3d/refine/icp_point2plane.md)(ICP、points × points × normals → pose)、[`estimate_flow`](../ops/3d/motion_segment/estimate_flow.md)(3D の流れ、points × points → flow_scattered)

## additive / manufacturing / printing

**318 本**

This cluster covers the full spectrum of additive manufacturing (AM) and 3D printing technologies, from material science and process optimization to structural design and applications across multiple industries. It addresses how layer-by-layer fabrication enables creation of complex geometries, lattice structures, and composite materials that would be difficult or impossible to produce through traditional manufacturing methods.

- **Material diversity in AM**: Polymers, ceramics, composites, and metals can be additively manufactured with tailored mechanical properties; preceramic polymers (PCPs) enable complex ceramic part fabrication
- **Topology optimization**: Design of lattice and spinodal architected structures with tunable anisotropy, porosity, and orientation to optimize performance across multiple scales
- **Process control and AI integration**: Closed-loop 3D printing with AI-augmented quality monitoring addresses parameter sensitivity (print speed, temperature) that can introduce structural defects
- **Composite reinforcement**: Continuous fiber-reinforced thermoset composites and multi-axis robotic integration enhance design flexibility and scalability
- **High-mass loading electrodes**: Nanostructured materials in energy storage applications achieve improved electrochemical performance through 3D printing geometry optimization

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- 付加製造(スライス・G-code・層検査): [`mesh_slice_contours`](../ops/printpath/slice/mesh_slice_contours.md)(メッシュを層の輪郭に、mesh → table)、[`mesh_slice_stack`](../ops/printpath/slice/mesh_slice_stack.md)(層マスクの積み、mesh → voxel)、[`contours_to_gcode`](../ops/printpath/slice/contours_to_gcode.md)(輪郭 → G-code、table → table)、[`gcode_read`](../ops/printpath/gcode/gcode_read.md)(G-code を線分の表に、text → table)、[`gcode_write`](../ops/printpath/gcode/gcode_write.md)(表 → G-code、table × text → text)、[`gcode_layer_image`](../ops/printpath/gcode/gcode_layer_image.md)(層の期待画像、table → image2d)、[`gcode_extrusion_volume`](../ops/printpath/gcode/gcode_extrusion_volume.md)(押し出し量、table → measurement)、[`gcode_time_estimate`](../ops/printpath/gcode/gcode_time_estimate.md)(所要時間、table → measurement)
- トポロジー最適化・格子構造の評価 —— 入口: 進化エンジン(`docs/ENGINE.md`、`docs/EVOLUTION_ENVIRONMENT.md`)は設計パラメータを適応度で回す側
- トポロジー最適化・格子構造の評価: [`vol_euler_number`](../ops/3d/feature/vol_euler_number.md)(連結性(閉じた空隙の数)、voxel → measurement)、[`vol_wall_thickness`](../ops/3d/probe/vol_wall_thickness.md)(最小肉厚、voxel → signal)、[`edt_jfa`](../ops/3d/feature/edt_jfa.md)(距離変換(肉厚・隙間)、voxel → sdf)、[`vol_granulometry`](../ops/3d/feature/vol_granulometry.md)(空隙の大きさ分布、voxel → measurement)、[`mesh_volume`](../ops/3d/mesh_process/mesh_volume.md)(体積(材料量)、mesh → measurement)、[`inertia_tensor`](../ops/3d/moment_invariant/inertia_tensor.md)(慣性テンソル、points → matrix)、[`principal_moments`](../ops/3d/moment_invariant/principal_moments.md)(主慣性モーメント、points → descriptor)
- in-situ 監視(メルトプール・高速動画): [`temporal_bandpass`](../ops/motionmag/temporal/temporal_bandpass.md)(動画の時間帯域(揺らぎ)、video → video)、[`motion_magnify`](../ops/motionmag/magnify/motion_magnify.md)(微小な動きの拡大、video → table)、[`video_spacetime_cube`](../ops/videocube/cube/video_spacetime_cube.md)(時空間の立方体、video → voxel)、[`video_summary_keyframes`](../ops/videocube/summary/video_summary_keyframes.md)(要約コマ、video → indices)、[`blob_count`](../ops/2d/features/blob_count.md)(スパッタ・粒の数、region → feature)、[`area_center`](../ops/2d/features/area_center.md)(溶融池の面積と重心、region → match)、[`volseq_magnify_motion`](../ops/live4d/time/volseq_magnify_motion.md)(3D+t の拍動の拡大、volseq → volseq)、[`focus_sweep_height_video`](../ops/live4d/render/focus_sweep_height_video.md)(焦点掃引 → 高さの時系列、volseq → video)
- 材料(見え方・組織・表面): [`spectrum_to_srgb`](../ops/optics/appearance/spectrum_to_srgb.md)(分光 → 色、signal → vector)、[`thin_film_reflectance`](../ops/optics/appearance/thin_film_reflectance.md)(薄膜の干渉色、signal → signal)、[`material_catalog`](../ops/optics/material/material_catalog.md)(材質の外観表、 → table)、[`oren_nayar`](../ops/optics/material/oren_nayar.md)(粗い面の反射、normalmap → image2d)、[`brdf_microfacet`](../ops/specular/reflectance/brdf_microfacet.md)(微小面の反射、normalmap → image2d)、[`metallic_flake_normals`](../ops/optics/surface/metallic_flake_normals.md)(メタリック塗装、 → normalmap)、[`corrosion_mask`](../ops/optics/surface/corrosion_mask.md)(腐食域、 → image2d)、[`cooc_feature_matrix`](../ops/2d/texture/cooc_feature_matrix.md)(組織のテクスチャ、image → feature)

## injection / molding / fault

**147 本**

This cluster covers injection molding as a manufacturing process, encompassing computer modeling, process optimization, quality control, and fault diagnosis. It addresses how advanced simulation, design optimization, and process parameter control are used to improve product quality, reduce defects, and enhance manufacturing efficiency across diverse applications from automotive to medical devices.

- **Computer modeling and simulation** are essential for optimizing injection molding without costly trial-and-error approaches
- **Process parameters** (temperature, pressure, cooling time, clamping force) directly impact dimensional accuracy, warpage, and surface quality
- **Cooling system design** (conformal and dynamic cooling) is critical for controlling mold temperature and reducing cycle time
- **Material-specific behavior** varies significantly—liquid silicone rubber, perfluoroalkoxy alkane, and other polymers require tailored process modeling
- **Fault diagnosis and quality metrics** include warpage, shrinkage, surface defects, and dimensional tolerances

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- 外観欠陥の検出(成形・表面): [`dc_local_contrast_norm`](../ops/2d/decomposition/dc_local_contrast_norm.md)(照明むらを除いた局所コントラスト、image → image)、[`dc_rpca_sparse`](../ops/2d/decomposition/dc_rpca_sparse.md)(背景から外れる疎な欠陥、image → image)、[`defect_contrast`](../ops/optics/illumination/defect_contrast.md)(照明条件での欠陥コントラスト、table → table)、[`illumination_design`](../ops/optics/illumination/illumination_design.md)(欠陥が出る照明の設計、 → table)、[`lighting_sweep`](../ops/optics/illumination/lighting_sweep.md)(照明を振って最良を探す、 → pairs)、[`auto_threshold`](../ops/2d/segmentation/auto_threshold.md)(二値化、image → region)、[`blob_count`](../ops/2d/features/blob_count.md)(欠陥の数、region → feature)、[`circularity`](../ops/2d/features/circularity.md)(形の記述、region → feature)
- 予知保全(振動・軸受): [`bearing_defect_frequencies`](../ops/acoustics/bearing/bearing_defect_frequencies.md)(軸受の欠陥周波数、 → table)、[`envelope_spectrum`](../ops/acoustics/bearing/envelope_spectrum.md)(包絡スペクトル、signal → table)、[`spectral_kurtosis`](../ops/acoustics/bearing/spectral_kurtosis.md)(衝撃の帯域、signal → table)、[`cepstrum`](../ops/acoustics/bearing/cepstrum.md)(ケプストラム、signal → table)、[`order_spectrum`](../ops/acoustics/order/order_spectrum.md)(次数スペクトル、signal → table)、[`stft`](../ops/acoustics/transform/stft.md)(時間周波数、signal → table)、[`spc_ewma`](../ops/spc/change/spc_ewma.md)(劣化の監視、signal → table)、[`motion_magnify`](../ops/motionmag/magnify/motion_magnify.md)(動画からの振動、video → table)
- 電源・電池(内部構造の CT): [`fbp_volume`](../ops/tomography/volume/fbp_volume.md)(電池 CT の再構成、sinostack → voxel)、[`vol_wall_thickness`](../ops/3d/probe/vol_wall_thickness.md)(電極・セパレータの厚み、voxel → signal)、[`vol_label`](../ops/3d/regionprops/vol_label.md)(層のラベル、voxel → labels)、[`vol_region_props`](../ops/3d/regionprops/vol_region_props.md)(層の性質、labels → table)、[`metal_trace_interpolate`](../ops/tomography/artifact/metal_trace_interpolate.md)(金属アーチファクト、sinogram → sinogram)、[`beam_hardening_correct`](../ops/tomography/artifact/beam_hardening_correct.md)(カッピング、sinogram → sinogram)

## materials / review / design

**811 本**

This cluster encompasses systematic reviews and syntheses of intervention designs, material properties, and environmental processes. It covers evidence-based evaluations of health interventions (obesity prevention, medical treatments), educational and behavioral design approaches, and physical system analyses (vegetation-climate interactions, cloud microphysics modeling).

- **Intervention review methodology**: Systematic synthesis of clinical trial evidence to assess effectiveness and safety across diverse health domains (nutrition, rehabilitation, acupuncture, parenteral nutrition)
- **Design evaluation frameworks**: Structured approaches to comparing intervention protocols, devices, and implementation methods for measurable outcomes
- **Behavioral and educational design**: Evidence-based strategies for modifying practices (complementary feeding, workplace ergonomics, preventive care)
- **Multi-scale physical modeling**: Comparative analysis of representation methods (bulk parameterization vs. spectral approaches) in complex systems
- **Occupational and environmental health design**: Work-break scheduling, ergonomic interventions, and exposure reduction strategies

**使う op**(テーマ → op の対応表から。ノートで型と例を確かめてから使う):

- 材料(見え方・組織・表面): [`spectrum_to_srgb`](../ops/optics/appearance/spectrum_to_srgb.md)(分光 → 色、signal → vector)、[`thin_film_reflectance`](../ops/optics/appearance/thin_film_reflectance.md)(薄膜の干渉色、signal → signal)、[`material_catalog`](../ops/optics/material/material_catalog.md)(材質の外観表、 → table)、[`oren_nayar`](../ops/optics/material/oren_nayar.md)(粗い面の反射、normalmap → image2d)、[`brdf_microfacet`](../ops/specular/reflectance/brdf_microfacet.md)(微小面の反射、normalmap → image2d)、[`metallic_flake_normals`](../ops/optics/surface/metallic_flake_normals.md)(メタリック塗装、 → normalmap)、[`corrosion_mask`](../ops/optics/surface/corrosion_mask.md)(腐食域、 → image2d)、[`cooc_feature_matrix`](../ops/2d/texture/cooc_feature_matrix.md)(組織のテクスチャ、image → feature)
- 文献のメタ議論(教育・レビュー) —— op なし(Fullseye の外)
- トポロジー最適化・格子構造の評価 —— 入口: 進化エンジン(`docs/ENGINE.md`、`docs/EVOLUTION_ENVIRONMENT.md`)は設計パラメータを適応度で回す側
- トポロジー最適化・格子構造の評価: [`vol_euler_number`](../ops/3d/feature/vol_euler_number.md)(連結性(閉じた空隙の数)、voxel → measurement)、[`vol_wall_thickness`](../ops/3d/probe/vol_wall_thickness.md)(最小肉厚、voxel → signal)、[`edt_jfa`](../ops/3d/feature/edt_jfa.md)(距離変換(肉厚・隙間)、voxel → sdf)、[`vol_granulometry`](../ops/3d/feature/vol_granulometry.md)(空隙の大きさ分布、voxel → measurement)、[`mesh_volume`](../ops/3d/mesh_process/mesh_volume.md)(体積(材料量)、mesh → measurement)、[`inertia_tensor`](../ops/3d/moment_invariant/inertia_tensor.md)(慣性テンソル、points → matrix)、[`principal_moments`](../ops/3d/moment_invariant/principal_moments.md)(主慣性モーメント、points → descriptor)
- 板金・成形(曲げ角・ひずみ): [`strain_from_displacement`](../ops/piv/solid/strain_from_displacement.md)(DIC の変位 → ひずみ、image2d × image2d → image2d)、[`piv_deform_pass`](../ops/piv/estimate/piv_deform_pass.md)(変形を追う相関、image2d × image2d × flow2d → flow2d)、[`correlation_quality`](../ops/piv/solid/correlation_quality.md)(相関の信頼度、image2d × image2d × flow2d → image2d)、[`speckle_quality`](../ops/piv/solid/speckle_quality.md)(スペックルの良さ、image2d → table)、[`angle_between_planes`](../ops/3d/geometry/angle_between_planes.md)(曲げ角、primitive → measurement)、[`ransac_plane`](../ops/3d/robust_fit/ransac_plane.md)(フランジ面、points → primitive)、[`fit_spline_curve`](../ops/3d/curve/fit_spline_curve.md)(曲げ線の当てはめ、points → points)、[`curvature_torsion`](../ops/3d/curve/curvature_torsion.md)(曲線の曲率、points → pairs)
